name: Law Firm Lead Generation & Intake Automation

nodes.name: Web Form Intake
nodes.notes: Receives POST from website consultation forms. Expected fields: firstName, lastName, phone, email, caseType, description, jurisdiction, urgency, adverseParty

nodes.name: Voice AI Intake
nodes.notes: Retell AI / Vapi post-call callback. Fields: callId, callerPhone, transcript, extractedData{firstName,lastName,email,caseType,urgency,adverseParty}

nodes.name: Chat Widget Intake
nodes.notes: Intercom / Drift / custom chat widget webhook after intake conversation completes

nodes.name: Email Intake
nodes.notes: Monitors intake@firmname.com — configure IMAP credentials in n8n

nodes.name: Referral Intake
nodes.notes: Receives referrals from attorney networks, Google Business, partner firms

nodes.name: Generate Engagement Letter - PandaDoc

_meta.description: Law Firm Lead Generation & Intake Automation

layers.1_intake: 5 channels: web form, voice AI (Retell/Vapi), chat widget, email (IMAP), referral
layers.2_qualification: Claude claude-sonnet-5-5 via Anthropic API — scores 0-100, routes to Qualified/Nurture/Disqualified
layers.3_conflict_check: Clio API + Jaro similarity fuzzy match — flags conflicts for mandatory attorney review
layers.4_follow_up: 14-day sequence: SMS (Day 1) → Email (Day 3) → Voice callback (Day 7) → Final email (Day 14)
layers.5_engagement_letter: PandaDoc template-based letter, e-signature, completion webhook
layers.6_pms_crm_sync: Clio matter creation, Airtable CRM record, attorney assignment, onboarding trigger

guardrails: AI never provides legal advice or case evaluations
All voice calls open with mandatory AI disclosure script
Conflict checks always flagged for attorney review — AI does not clear conflicts
Engagement letters use firm-approved PandaDoc templates only
Confidentiality notice included in every outbound communication
Unsubscribe mechanism in all follow-up emails per CAN-SPAM and state bar rules
